in_marathi.name: Ekavir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One with God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekavir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekavir is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Eka' meaning one and 'Vir' meaning God or hero. This name signifies being one with the divine and having the qualities of a hero.
